subject: Request: Executive clearance for >20% Hosted usage discount — Northbridge Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Porter <alex.porter@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal commercial - request for deep hosted discount (Northbridge)

Tessa —

Quick summary: Northbridge is asking for a 28% discount on Hosted API usage pricing in order to sign an 18-month renewal and increase committed average monthly usage to ~10M tokens. Their procurement team wants the concession documented in the SOW/addendum and prefers a single vendor agreement.

Why this matters:
- Strategic reference (pilot of clinical search running in prod across 3 hospitals)
- Marketplace lead-gen promise if they move forward with the integration
- Churn risk if we don't get terms to match competitive offers they received

Ask: This request exceeds the standard delegated discount band (>20%) and requires executive clearance. Recommend we sanction a 25% discount for the first 9 months with a usage ramp clause (min monthly commit) and automatic step-down to 15% for months 10–18. This preserves some margin while giving them an upfront incentive.

Impact: Attached is the margin breakdown and pricing calc. High level: at 25% for 9 months our blended gross margin on Hosted usage holds around 34% with the commit. Without concession, we risk losing the account.

Attachments: [Attachment: northbridge_ma-deal-deck.pdf (pdf)], [Attachment: pricing_calc_breakdown.xlsx (xlsx)]

Next steps: Approve (yes/no) or propose alternate percentage / contract structure and I will notify Alex and loop in Legal/Finance. If you want I can draft the SOW addendum and route DocuSign.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[Sent from mobile]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Porter <alex.porter@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal commercial - request for deep hosted discount (Northbridge)

Ben — thanks for the clear summary. A couple of clarifying Qs before I escalate to Mina:

- What’s the downside if we offer 22% instead of 25% for the same term? (need incremental revenue delta)
- Can we structure the concession as an enrollment credit tied to token thresholds rather than a permanent list price reduction? That helps with reporting and future renewals.
- Legal/Finance: can we get the SOW addendum language to require minimum monthly billing and an audit right?

Alex — appreciate patience while we pull internal approvals. Ben will share a short amendment draft if we get the green light.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-29T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal commercial - request for deep hosted discount (Northbridge)

Tessa / Ben —

I ran the numbers (see attached pricing_calc_breakdown.xlsx). Short answer: 22% gets us close to the margin floor for committed 10M tokens/mo, but 25% for 9 months then a step-down preserves more ARR and gives Northbridge the headline reduction they want. If Legal adds the minimum monthly billing and a clawback if they underdeliver on commit, we can accept the temporary concession.

Recommendation: escalate for Mina's sign-off with the following conditional terms:
- 25% off Hosted usage for months 1–9 (must hit 8M tokens/mo average across months 1–3 to avoid clawback)
- 15% off months 10–18 (automatic)
- Prepay option available for additional 5% uplift to Redwood (optional for customer)
- SOW addendum to include audit right and termination language if thresholds not met

Attachment: [Attachment: pricing_calc_breakdown.xlsx (xlsx)]

On Tue, May 29, 2028 at 11:42 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Ben — thanks for the clear summary. A couple of clarifying Qs before I escalate to Mina: ...

Thanks,
Rishi
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Porter <alex.porter@northbridgehealth.com>, Legal Team <legal@redwoodinference.com>, Finance Ops <finance.ops@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Approve: Northbridge Hosted usage concession (conditional)

Folks —

I reviewed Rishi's recommendation and the attached economics. I will approve an exception to allow a >20% hosted usage concession with the following firm conditions:

- Approve 25% off Hosted usage for months 1–6; then 20% for months 7–18 (this reduces time on deeper concession but closes the deal)
- Must include min monthly billing thresholds and an audit right in the SOW addendum
- Finance to sign off on recognized revenue treatment before DocuSign
- Legal to prepare an addendum with clawback language and the prepay optionality as described
- Sales to secure a PO and procurement contact on the DocuSign envelope before routing

Ben — you have executive clearance to offer the above. Please update the SOW addendum and route to Alex with the DocuSign link; loop Legal/Finance for final sign-off. Copy me on the envelope.

Mina Haddad
Senior Director, Commercial Strategy — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sow_addendum_stub.pdf (pdf)]
